high.title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate in Strait of Hormuz, Tankers Turning Back
high.summary: Iran has attacked at least nine tanker vessels since July 6, causing a significant decline in shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil supply route. One sailor was killed and multiple crew members injured in separate attacks on oil tankers Al Bahyah and Mombasa B. This escalation poses direct risks to global oil supply chains and energy prices, with potential knock-on effects for Indonesian energy costs and Pertamina's import operations.

high.title: JCI Rallies at Week's End, Rises to 6,175 – Foreign Investors Net Buy Rp 638 Billion
high.summary: The Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) surged 4.24% over the trading week of July 13–17, 2026, closing at 6,175.535 — recovering from 5,924.360 the prior week. Foreign investors recorded a net buy of Rp 638.05 billion on Friday alone, signaling renewed short-term interest. However, year-to-date net foreign selling remains deeply negative at over Rp 75.7 trillion, highlighting persistent long-term outflow concerns.

high.title: JCI Closes in Green, Up 1.10% to 6,108 – TBIG Prepares Digital Business Expansion, PNGO Enters Mandatory Tender Offer Period
high.summary: The JCI gained 1.10% on Thursday, July 16, closing at 6,108.21, driven by gains in ASII, BMRI, and BBCA. Foreign investors posted net buying of Rp 283.41 billion on the regular market and approximately Rp 1.22 trillion across all markets, supported by banking and commodity sector flows. All sectoral indices closed in positive territory, with the technology sector leading gains at 1.94%, while US markets weakened with the S&P 500 falling 0.51%.

high.title: Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim Reveals Malaysian Civil Servant Pension Fund Lost Nearly RM 200 Million in Indonesian Startup eFishery Fraud
high.summary: Malaysia's Retirement Fund (KWAP) invested nearly RM 200 million (approximately Rp 860 billion) in Indonesian aquaculture startup eFishery, which committed financial fraud through manipulation of its financial statements. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim confirmed the loss in a written parliamentary response on July 15, 2026, stating the investment went through proper governance and was backed by internationally certified auditors. This scandal further damages Indonesia's startup investment credibility and raises serious governance concerns for foreign institutional investors considering Indonesian tech ventures.

high.title: DJP Strengthens Tax Compliance Surveillance: Web Scraping to Law Enforcement Cooperation
high.summary: Indonesia's Directorate General of Taxes (DJP) has issued Circular Letter SE-8/PJ/2026 outlining stricter taxpayer compliance monitoring, employing both field visits and non-field digital methods including web scraping technology. This represents a significant escalation in tax enforcement efforts that could directly impact businesses and individual taxpayers across Indonesia. Companies should review their tax compliance posture as authorities now leverage advanced data collection tools to identify unreported tax subjects and objects.

high.title: Malaysian Pension Fund Loses ~RM 200 Million in eFishery Startup Fraud
high.summary: Malaysia's civil servant pension fund KWAP lost nearly RM 200 million (approx. Rp 860 billion) invested in Indonesian aquaculture startup eFishery due to financial report manipulation by its management. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim confirmed the loss directly to the Malaysian parliament, noting the investment had passed standard governance and audit processes. This is a significant reputational and investor confidence blow for Indonesia's startup ecosystem, potentially dampening future foreign institutional investment in Indonesian tech ventures.

high.title: IHSG Closes Higher at 6,175 Heading into the Weekend
high.summary: Indonesia's benchmark stock index (IHSG) closed up 67 points (1.10%) at 6,175 on Friday, July 17, 2026, opening in the green at 6,112. Trading activity was robust with a total transaction value of IDR 14.79 trillion involving 28.48 billion shares traded in over 2 million transactions. This positive close signals improving market sentiment heading into the weekend.

high.title: Pos Indonesia Delays Sukuk Payment of IDR 24.11 Billion Due to Financial Difficulties
high.summary: State-owned PT Pos Indonesia has delayed payment on its Sukuk Ijarah Berkelanjutan I Series A-C installment worth IDR 24.11 billion, citing liquidity constraints, though the company insists this is a deferral and not a default. The company has formally notified all relevant parties and disclosed its cash position as the underlying reason for the delay. This raises concerns about the financial health of the state postal company and its ability to meet future debt obligations.

medium.title: Indonesia Becomes Founding Member of World AI Cooperation Organization (WAICO) Alongside China
medium.summary: Indonesia officially became a founding member of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO), with the signing ceremony held in Shanghai, China, as directed by President Prabowo Subianto. As a founding member, Indonesia gains first-access rights to all discussions on AI development and governance at the international level. This signals Indonesia's strategic commitment to inclusive and responsible AI development, which could have significant implications for the country's digital economy and technology sector.

medium.title: Airlangga Signs WAICO Founding Document — Indonesia Ready to Strengthen Global AI Cooperation
medium.summary: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto signed the founding agreement of WAICO in Shanghai, establishing it as an independent intergovernmental international organization with international legal personality. The move is aligned with President Prabowo's agenda to accelerate sustainable development goals and boost economic growth through international AI cooperation. This represents a formal diplomatic and economic commitment that may open new avenues for technology investment and collaboration for Indonesian businesses.

medium.title: Indonesian Coffee Breaks Into Morocco and China Markets via Warehouse Receipt System
medium.summary: Indonesia's Commodity Futures Trading Supervisory Agency (Bappebti) exported two containers of coffee totaling 38.4 tons worth approximately US$227,443 (around IDR 4.08 billion) to China and Morocco, shipped from the KAI-ASLI Warehouse Receipt System (SRG) facility in Bandung. An additional eight containers of Arabica Semi-Wash coffee (153.6 tons, valued at ~IDR 22.45 billion) are also set to be exported to China. This highlights the growing effectiveness of Indonesia's Warehouse Receipt System in boosting commodity competitiveness and expanding market access for local farmers and businesses.

medium.title: Tax Directorate General Launches New Taxpayer Compliance Surveillance Methods
medium.summary: Indonesia's Directorate General of Taxes (DJP) has issued Circular Letter SE-8/PJ/2026 outlining two new methods to monitor taxpayer compliance: direct field visits to residences and business locations, and non-field data collection using information technology. This signals a more aggressive tax enforcement approach that could affect businesses and individual taxpayers across Indonesia, potentially increasing state revenue collection.

medium.title: National Nutrition Agency (BGN) Carries Rp 1.6 Trillion in Unpaid Debt from 2025
medium.summary: Indonesia's National Nutrition Agency (BGN) has disclosed Rp 1.6 trillion in outstanding payables to third-party vendors from completed 2025 activities that remain unpaid. The agency plans to settle these obligations through a carryover mechanism under the 2026 budget allocation (DIPA 2026). This highlights fiscal management concerns within a key government program and may affect vendors and suppliers involved in national nutrition initiatives.

medium.title: Four Companies Queue for IPO on Indonesia Stock Exchange
medium.summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) has confirmed four companies in the IPO pipeline as of July 17, 2026, comprising two small-scale asset companies (under Rp 50 billion) and two large-scale asset companies (above Rp 250 billion). The pipeline includes firms from basic materials, consumer non-cyclicals, and two from the healthcare sector. Investors should monitor these upcoming listings for potential opportunities, particularly in the healthcare segment.

medium.title: Pertamina Reports Fuel Supply in North Sumatra Returning to Normal After Disruption
medium.summary: Pertamina Patra Niaga reports that fuel distribution in North Sumatra is stabilizing following a recent supply disruption, with queues at gas stations gradually easing as monitored via CCTV and field inspections. The company's independent commissioner confirmed fuel stocks remain adequate and urged the public to avoid panic buying. The situation is relevant for assessing Pertamina's operational resilience and regional energy distribution capabilities.

medium.title: SME Products Can Now Be Listed in Modern Retail Outlets Without Administrative Fees
medium.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of SMEs and the Indonesian Retail Business Association (Aprindo) signed a cooperation agreement to waive listing fees for SMEs supplying products to modern retail chains. Aprindo represents over 500 modern retail companies in Indonesia, significantly expanding the potential market access for small businesses. The initiative aims to help quality SME products penetrate not only modern retail but also hotels, industrial buyers, and digital marketplaces.

medium.title: Antam Gold Price Falls Rp 21,000 Per Gram Over the Past Week
medium.summary: Antam 24-karat gold prices declined by Rp 21,000 per gram over the trading week of July 13–18, 2026, closing at Rp 2,614,000 per gram after opening the week at Rp 2,635,000. The weekly high reached Rp 2,635,000 while the low touched Rp 2,606,000 per gram. This downward movement may reflect easing safe-haven demand as the JCI recovered during the same period.

medium.title: MSCI Tightens Screening Methodology for Stocks with Extreme Price Increases Ahead of August 2026 Index Review
medium.summary: Global index provider MSCI has updated its Extreme Price Increase (EPI) screening methodology, effective from the August 2026 Index Review. Stocks flagged as EPI with a Foreign Inclusion Factor (FIF) of 0.75 or higher will be exempt from EPI screening and remain eligible for the Standard Index, while those with FIF below 0.75 face stricter eligibility conditions. Indonesian investors should monitor which local stocks may be affected, as index inclusion or exclusion can significantly impact foreign capital flows.

medium.title: Latest Food Commodity Prices: Chicken Prices Rise, Rice Remains Stable
medium.summary: According to Bank Indonesia's Strategic Food Price Information Center (PIHPS), food commodity prices moved variably on July 19, 2026, with green cayenne pepper rising 5.26% to IDR 53,000/kg and fresh chicken meat climbing 3.92% to IDR 38,450/kg, while red cayenne pepper fell 4.34%. These price fluctuations are relevant inflation indicators monitored by Bank Indonesia and could influence monetary policy considerations. Investors in the food and consumer staples sectors should note ongoing volatility in key commodity prices.

medium.title: Bulog Chief Reveals Status of Rice Social Assistance Program Continuation into July 2026
medium.summary: Bulog Director Ahmad Rizal Ramdhani confirmed that the government's rice food assistance program (10kg per recipient) is set to continue for the next three months, with Bulog holding sufficient rice stocks. However, distribution is pending as the National Food Agency (Bapanas) awaits the release of supplementary budget approval (ABT) from the Ministry of Finance. This update is relevant for monitoring government expenditure commitments, food security policy, and Bulog's operational dynamics.

medium.title: Coordinating Minister Airlangga: Indonesia Can Become a Global AI Development Hub
medium.summary: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto reaffirmed Indonesia's ambition to be an active participant and architect in global AI development, not merely a consumer market, speaking at the founding meeting of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO). The government's stance signals potential future policy frameworks and investment incentives aimed at building a domestic AI and digital economy ecosystem. This could open opportunities for technology sector investment and public-private partnerships in Indonesia.

medium.title: SME Products Can Now Enter Modern Retail Chains Without Paying Listing Fees
medium.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of SMEs and the Indonesian Retail Entrepreneurs Association (Aprindo) have signed a partnership agreement to waive administrative listing fees for SMEs seeking to supply products to modern retail chains, covering over 500 retail companies. This regulatory move lowers barriers for small businesses to access formal retail channels, potentially boosting SME revenues and product visibility across modern trade, hospitality, and digital markets. Investors in the retail and consumer goods sectors should note the expected increase in SME-sourced product variety on shelves.

medium.title: Antam Gold Price Falls Rp 21,000 Per Gram Over the Past Week
medium.summary: Antam 24-karat gold prices declined by Rp 21,000 per gram over the trading week of July 13–18, 2026, closing at Rp 2,614,000 per gram after reaching a weekly high of Rp 2,635,000. The weekly dip may reflect profit-taking or easing safe-haven demand among Indonesian retail investors. Those holding gold as a hedge should monitor whether this downward trend continues into the following week.

medium.title: MSCI Tightens Rules for Stocks with Extreme Price Increases, Effective August 2026 Index Review
medium.summary: Global index provider MSCI has updated and tightened its methodology for screening stocks with Extreme Price Increases (EPI), with new rules taking effect at the August 2026 Index Review. Stocks flagged as EPI with a Foreign Inclusion Factor (FIF) of 0.75 or higher will be exempt from the EPI screening and remain eligible for the Standard Index, while those with FIF below 0.75 face stricter inclusion conditions. This change may affect the index eligibility of certain Indonesian stocks that have experienced sharp price surges.

medium.title: Indonesia's Tax Authority Deploys Web Scraping and Law Enforcement Partnerships to Chase Tax Compliance
medium.summary: Indonesia's Directorate General of Taxes (DJP) has issued Circular Letter SE-8/PJ/2026 outlining stricter taxpayer compliance monitoring, employing both field visits and non-field data collection methods including web scraping and technology-based surveillance. The dual approach aims to identify unreported tax subjects and objects more efficiently without relying solely on physical inspections. Businesses and individual taxpayers should be aware of the heightened digital monitoring capabilities now being deployed by tax authorities.
